January.task: Maintain 5cm standing water in Rabi paddy
Monitor for brown plant hopper; apply Imidacloprid if needed

February.task: Harvest Rabi paddy when 85% grains are golden-yellow
Inspect for stem borer egg masses

March.task: Threshing, drying paddy to 14% moisture for storage
Prepare nursery beds for Zaid paddy if applicable

April.task: Raise 25-day nursery for early Kharif paddy
Ensure adequate water before transplanting season

May.task: Kharif nursery sowing: Swarna, MTU-7029, IR-64 varieties
Apply FYM @10 t/ha to main field 2 weeks before transplanting

June.task: Keep 2-5 cm water level post-transplanting for 3 weeks
Basal: N 30 + P 40 + K 40 kg/ha at transplanting

July.task: 1st top-dressing: N @30 kg/ha at tillering (21 DAT)
Scout for blast disease; apply Tricyclazole if lesions found
Alternate wetting and drying after active tillering

August.task: 2nd top-dressing: N @20 kg/ha at panicle initiation (42 DAT)
Monitor for gall midge; use Carbofuran 3G granules
Ensure 5 cm standing water at booting and flowering stages

September.task: Apply Propiconazole for sheath blight if >5% incidence
Drain field 10 days before harvest to aid ripening

October.task: Harvest when 80-85% grains are ripe (golden yellow)
Protect stored grain from weevils with Aluminium Phosphide

November.task: Complete Kharif threshing; dry to <= 14% moisture
Start Rabi paddy nursery in coastal/southern districts

December.task: Transplant Rabi nursery; apply basal fertilizer
Ensure adequate moisture in Rabi transplanted fields

activities: Nursery bed preparation (10% of main field area)
Wet bed or dry bed sowing with sprouted seeds
Maintain thin layer of water (1-2 cm) in nursery
stages.irrigation: Keep nursery bed saturated; avoid deep submergence of young sprouts
stages.nutrition: Apply 10 kg Urea + 10 kg SSP per 1000 m2 nursery area
stages.plantProtection: Monitor for stem borer and thrips; seed treatment with Carbendazim 2g/kg

activities: Transplant 2-3 seedlings per hill at 20x15 cm spacing
Gap filling within 7-10 days of transplanting
Cono-weeder or manual weeding at 20 and 40 DAT
stages.irrigation: Maintain 2-5 cm shallow standing water; practice alternate wetting and drying (AWD)
stages.nutrition: 1st Top dressing: 30 kg Nitrogen/ha at 21 DAT during active tillering
stages.plantProtection: Scout for blast, gall midge, and whorl maggot; apply Cartap Hydrochloride if threshold exceeded

activities: Monitor panicle primordium development
Maintain field bunds to prevent nutrient leakage
Rogue out off-type and wild rice plants
stages.irrigation: Maintain steady 5 cm standing water (most drought-sensitive stage)
stages.nutrition: 2nd Top dressing: 25 kg Nitrogen + 20 kg Potash (K2O)/ha at panicle initiation
stages.plantProtection: Preventive spray of Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 0.6g/L for neck and panicle blast

activities: Anthesis and milk-to-dough stage development
Keep field free of birds and rodent traps
Foliar spray of 1% Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45) for grain weight boost
stages.irrigation: Maintain 2-3 cm water till dough stage; drain field 10-12 days before anticipated harvest
stages.nutrition: Avoid excess Nitrogen to prevent lodging and sheath rot
stages.plantProtection: Monitor for brown plant hopper (BPH) at base of plants; spray Pymetrozine 50 WG @ 0.6g/L

activities: Reap when 80-85% of grains turn golden yellow
Combine harvesting or manual sickle cutting followed by mechanical thresher
Sun dry harvested paddy on clean threshing floor
stages.irrigation: Completely drained dry field for easy machinery movement and uniform ripening
stages.nutrition: No fertilizer application during ripening
stages.plantProtection: Store cleaned grain in airtight bags; fumigate with Aluminum Phosphide if weevil observed

landSoilRequirements.fieldPreparation: 2-3 summer ploughings followed by puddling with cage wheels. Level field thoroughly using laser land leveler to ensure uniform water depth.

irrigationRequirements.method: Controlled Basin Irrigation or Alternate Wetting & Drying (AWD)
irrigationRequirements.intervals: Keep continuous 2-5 cm submergence during tillering and panicle initiation, then AWD until 10 days before harvest.

fertilizerNutrientRequirements.basalApplication: Apply 50% N + 100% P + 50% K + Zinc Sulphate 25 kg/ha at final puddling.
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.topDressing: 25% N at active tillering (21 DAT) and remaining 25% N + 50% K at panicle initiation (45-50 DAT).
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate 21% @ 25 kg/ha basal to prevent Khaira deficiency.
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.organicBiofertilizers: Incorporate FYM @ 10 tonnes/ha or green manuring with Sesbania (Dhaincha) before puddling; Azospirillum @ 2 kg/ha seed treatment.

sowingPlantingInfo.sowingWindow: Kharif: May 20 - June 25 (Nursery), June 15 - July 20 (Transplanting); Rabi: Nov 15 - Dec 20
sowingPlantingInfo.spacing: 20 cm row-to-row x 15 cm plant-to-plant (2-3 seedlings/hill)
sowingPlantingInfo.sowingDepth: Transplant shallow at 2 - 3 cm depth for rapid rooting
sowingPlantingInfo.seedTreatment: Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2g/kg + Streptocycline @ 0.1g/kg seed in 1 liter water for 12 hours

weedingRequirements.herbicideRecommendations: Pre-emergence: Pretilachlor 50 EC @ 600 ml/acre within 3 days of transplanting in standing water; Post-emergence: Bispyribac sodium 10 SC @ 80 ml/acre at 20-25 DAT.
weedingRequirements.manualInterculture: Run Cono-weeder or rotary weeder between rows at 20 DAT and 40 DAT to aerate roots.

majorPests: Yellow Stem Borer (Dead heart, white ear)
preventiveCulturalPractices: Avoid excessive nitrogen application
Install pheromone traps @ 5/acre for stem borer
Maintain field bunds free of weed hosts
Follow alternate wetting and drying to curb BPH

weatherClimate.weatherAlerts: Heavy rainfall during flowering washes away pollen; drain standing water immediately if cyclone or flash flooding occurs.

machineryEquipment: Tractor with cage wheels and rotavator
irrigationInfrastructure: Canal outlets, tubewell/borewell with PVC delivery pipelines
Level field bunds with drainage sluice gates
storageHandling: Hermetic grain storage bags (PICS bags) or galvanized steel bins

harvestingPeriod.maturityIndicators: 85% grains in panicle turn golden straw color; flag leaf senesces; grains produce metallic crack sound when bitten.
harvestingPeriod.harvestMoisture: 18% - 20% moisture during field cutting; dry immediately to 12% - 14% for long-term safe storage.
harvestingPeriod.postHarvestCare: Thresh within 24 hours of cutting to prevent fungal development; dry slowly under mild sun; store in cool, rodent-proof godown.

January.task: 2nd N top-dressing @30 kg/ha at CRI stage
Monitor yellow rust; apply Propiconazole if spotted

February.task: Scout for aphids; spray Dimethoate 30 EC if severe
Foliar spray of 2% urea at grain filling for yield boost

March.task: Harvest when moisture is 12-14% and straw turns golden

April.task: Threshing and cleaning; store in moisture-proof bags

May.task: Pre-monsoon field preparation: deep summer ploughing
Apply 5 t/ha FYM/compost and incorporate into soil

June.task: Green manuring: sow Dhaincha/Sunhemp before wheat season

July.task: Control weeds in pre-sowing field preparation

August.task: Field levelling and layout of irrigation channels
Soil testing; apply Zinc Sulphate @25 kg/ha if deficient

September.task: Arrange certified seed of HD-2967, GW-322, PBW-343 varieties

October.task: Timely sowing: Oct 15-Nov 15 is optimal window
Seed treatment with Thiram + Carbendazim @2.5 g/kg seed
Basal: N 60 + P 60 + K 40 kg/ha at sowing

November.task: Late sowing with late varieties (HD-2781, WR-544) if delayed
1st irrigation at Crown Root Initiation (CRI) stage 20-25 DAS

December.task: 1st N top-dressing @30 kg/ha at 1st node stage
Maintain soil moisture; 2nd irrigation if dry

activities: First critical irrigation
First weeding and hoeing
Check for termite activity
stages.irrigation: Most critical irrigation (20-25 DAS); water stress here reduces yield by 30%
stages.nutrition: 1st Top dressing: 30 kg Nitrogen (65 kg Urea)/ha immediately after first irrigation
stages.plantProtection: Pre-emergence weed control with Pendimethalin 30 EC @ 1 L/acre

activities: Second irrigation at late tillering (40-45 DAS)
Secondary root establishment
Broadleaf weed spray
stages.irrigation: Irrigate at 40-45 DAS; avoid standing water in heavy soils
stages.nutrition: 2nd Top dressing: 30 kg Nitrogen/ha at first node stage
stages.plantProtection: Spray 2,4-D Ethyl Ester @ 250 ml/acre or Metsulfuron-methyl @ 8g/acre for broadleaf weeds

activities: Third irrigation at booting stage (65-70 DAS)
Scout for yellow rust pustules on upper leaves
Foliar spray of Zinc Sulphate if deficiency noticed
stages.irrigation: Light irrigation at ear emergence; do not irrigate in high winds to prevent lodging
stages.nutrition: Foliar spray of 2% Urea + 0.5% Zinc Sulphate for grain spikelet fertility
stages.plantProtection: Spray Propiconazole 25 EC (Tilt) @ 1 ml/L on initial yellow/brown rust signs

activities: Grain filling and starch accumulation
Protect from bird damage in early morning/evening
Fourth irrigation at milk stage
stages.irrigation: Maintain soil moisture at grain filling; cease irrigation 15 days before harvest
stages.nutrition: Foliar spray of 1% Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45) to enhance 1000-grain weight
stages.plantProtection: Monitor for head aphids; spray Thiamethoxam 25 WG @ 0.3g/L if population exceeds 5 per ear head

activities: Harvest when grain is flinty hard and straw is dry and brittle
Combine harvesting or reaper threshing
Sun-dry grain to <= 12% moisture
stages.irrigation: Dry field conditions required for harvest
stages.nutrition: Nil
stages.plantProtection: Treat storage bins with Malathion 50 EC spray before storage

landSoilRequirements.fieldPreparation: 1 deep summer ploughing followed by 2-3 cultivator passes and planking to create a fine, weed-free, firm seedbed.

irrigationRequirements.method: Border Strip, Furrow, or Sprinkler Irrigation
irrigationRequirements.intervals: 4 to 6 light irrigations spaced 18-22 days apart depending on winter rain.

fertilizerNutrientRequirements.basalApplication: Apply 50% N + 100% P + 100% K at sowing in seed-cum-fertilizer drill.
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.topDressing: 25% N at first irrigation (CRI stage) and remaining 25% N at second irrigation (Jointing).
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate 21% @ 25 kg/ha basal once in 2 years.
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.organicBiofertilizers: FYM @ 5-8 tonnes/ha incorporated during field preparation; Azotobacter + PSB seed treatment @ 200g/10kg seed.

sowingPlantingInfo.sowingWindow: Timely sowing: November 1 - November 20; Late sowing: November 25 - December 15
sowingPlantingInfo.spacing: 20 - 22.5 cm row-to-row x continuous seed drop
sowingPlantingInfo.sowingDepth: 4 - 5 cm in moist zone (Avoid deeper sowing which delays CRI emergence)
sowingPlantingInfo.seedTreatment: Carboxin + Thiram (Vitavax Power) @ 2.5g/kg seed for loose smut prevention

weedingRequirements.herbicideRecommendations: Pre-emergence: Pendimethalin 30 EC @ 1 L/acre within 2 DAS; Post-emergence: Sulfosulfuron 75 WG @ 13.5 g/acre + Metsulfuron @ 8 g/acre at 30-35 DAS.
weedingRequirements.manualInterculture: One hand weeding at 30-35 DAS if herbicide not applied.

preventiveCulturalPractices: Use certified rust-resistant varieties (HD-2967, HD-3086, DBW-187, DBW-303)
Seed treatment with Chlorpyrifos for termite prone fields
Avoid excessive nitrogen in humid cloudy weather

weatherClimate.optimumTemperature: 15°C - 20°C during tillering; 20°C - 25°C during heading and grain filling
weatherClimate.weatherAlerts: Terminal heat stress (temperatures > 32°C in March) causes forced maturity; spray Potassium Nitrate 1% or provide light irrigation to cool canopy.

machineryEquipment: Tractor with Zero-Till drill or Happy Seeder
irrigationInfrastructure: Underground pipeline network or sprinkler sets to prevent deep percolation
storageHandling: Metal grain silos or HDPE woven bags with polythene liner

harvestingPeriod.maturityIndicators: Grain becomes hard and dough turns firm; straw turns completely yellow and dry; moisture drops below 14%.
harvestingPeriod.postHarvestCare: Separate chaff, winnow, dry for 2 sunny days, store with neem leaves or dry sand sealing.

January.task: Destroy crop stubbles to eliminate bollworm overwintering
Apply green manure to field after cotton harvest

February.task: Deep ploughing (30 cm) for summer; field levelling
Apply 8-10 t FYM/ha and incorporate well

March.task: Prepare ridges and furrows; layout irrigation channels
Install light traps @1/ha to monitor early season pests

April.task: Sowing: Bt cotton hybrids (Vikram, MRC-7017); 90x60 cm
Basal: P 80 + K 40 + Boron 2 kg/ha at sowing

May.task: Gap filling at 10-15 DAS using pre-germinated seeds
Monitor for thrips and jassids; spray Imidacloprid if needed
N top-dressing: 40 kg/ha at squaring stage

June.task: Irrigate once per week in dry spells; avoid waterlogging
Apply 20 kg Sulphur/ha at boll development

July.task: 2nd N top-dressing @40 kg/ha at boll initiation
Scout for pink bollworm; apply Emamectin Benzoate @0.4 g/L
Critical irrigation at boll filling stage

August.task: Monitor white fly population; use sticky yellow traps
Apply Neem oil 2% for sucking pest management

September.task: American bollworm: spray Spinosad 45% SC @3.5 mL/10L
First picking of open bolls when fluffiness is full

October.task: 2nd and 3rd picking; pick in dry weather to prevent staining
Apply defoliant (Ethephon) for uniform boll opening if needed

November.task: Final picking; avoid mixing trash with lint
Sun-dry cotton to <=8% moisture before ginning/sale

December.task: Complete harvest; remove and burn leftover crop residue
Apply 5 t/ha FYM to restore soil organic matter

activities: Ridge and furrow formation
Sow 1-2 seeds per dibbling spot at 90x60 cm
Gap filling with pre-soaked seed within 10 days
stages.irrigation: Light irrigation immediately after dibbling or sow on ridges under rainfed monsoon
stages.nutrition: Basal: 25% N + 100% P + 50% K applied 5 cm below and to the side of seed
stages.plantProtection: Seed treatment with Imidacloprid 70 WS @ 7g/kg for 30-day sucking pest protection

activities: Thinning to single vigorous plant per hill at 20 DAS
Inter-cultivation with blade harrow (Danti)
Monitor for square formation and early thrips
stages.irrigation: Irrigate every 10-14 days; avoid standing water on black soils
stages.nutrition: 1st Top dressing: 35% Nitrogen at 35-40 DAS during squaring stage
stages.plantProtection: Install yellow and blue sticky traps; spray Neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 3 ml/L for whiteflies

activities: Peak flowering and young boll development
Nipper / detopping terminal shoots at 90-100 DAS to redirect energy to bolls
Scout for pink bollworm inside rosette flowers
stages.irrigation: Critical irrigation stage; ensure soil moisture during flowering to prevent boll shed
stages.nutrition: 2nd Top dressing: 25% Nitrogen + 50% Potash at 65-70 DAS; foliar spray of 1% Magnesium Sulphate + 0.2% Boron
stages.plantProtection: Install Pink Bollworm pheromone traps @ 8/acre; spray Emamectin Benzoate 5 SG @ 0.4g/L if moth catch > 8/day

activities: Boll maturation and lint expansion
Protect from boll rot during unseasonal rains
First picking of fluffy opened bolls in dry sunny weather
stages.irrigation: Light irrigations; cease all irrigation 15 days before major boll opening
stages.nutrition: Foliar spray of 2% Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45) twice at 15-day interval for boll size
stages.plantProtection: Spray Spinosad 45 SC @ 0.3 ml/L if American bollworm detected

activities: Pick clean cotton in dry afternoon hours (avoid morning dew)
Separate trash, dried bracts, and stained cotton from clean lint
Sun-dry seed cotton (Kapas) on clean canvas
stages.irrigation: Completely dry soil
stages.nutrition: Nil
stages.plantProtection: Destroy crop residue and graze cattle to prevent pink bollworm carryover

landSoilRequirements.fieldPreparation: Deep summer ploughing (25-30 cm) to break hardpan; 2 harrowings followed by ridger to form ridges and furrows at 90 cm interval.

irrigationRequirements.method: Drip Irrigation (Recommended) or Alternate Furrow Irrigation
irrigationRequirements.intervals: Irrigate every 8-12 days depending on evapotranspiration and soil moisture.

fertilizerNutrientRequirements.basalApplication: Apply 25% N + 100% P + 50% K + 25 kg/ha Zinc Sulphate + 10 kg/ha Borax.
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.topDressing: 35% N at squaring (35-40 DAS), 25% N + 50% K at peak flowering (65-70 DAS), 15% N at boll formation (85-90 DAS).
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.micronutrients: Foliar spray of 1% Magnesium Sulphate + 0.5% Zinc Sulphate to prevent red leaf disease (leaf reddening).
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.organicBiofertilizers: FYM @ 10 tonnes/ha; VAM (Mycorrhiza) @ 5 kg/ha at root zone for phosphorus uptake.

sowingPlantingInfo.sowingWindow: Kharif: May 15 - June 25 with pre-monsoon irrigation; June 15 - July 10 under rainfed conditions
sowingPlantingInfo.seedRatePerAcre: 1.5 - 2.0 kg/acre (Bt hybrid packets including refuge seed)
sowingPlantingInfo.spacing: 90 cm x 60 cm (Low rainfall) or 120 cm x 45 cm (Drip fertile fields)
sowingPlantingInfo.seedTreatment: Bt hybrid seed is pre-treated; for non-Bt treat with Imidacloprid 70 WS @ 7g/kg + Trichoderma viride @ 4g/kg

weedingRequirements.herbicideRecommendations: Pre-emergence: Pendimethalin 30 EC @ 1.25 L/acre within 48 hours of sowing; Post-emergence directed: Quizalofop-ethyl 5 EC @ 400 ml/acre for grass weeds at 25 DAS.
weedingRequirements.manualInterculture: Inter-cultivation with bullock or tractor drawn cultivator at 25, 45, and 65 DAS followed by hand weeding.

preventiveCulturalPractices: Install pheromone traps @ 8/acre by 45 DAS
Destroy and burn stubbles immediately after final picking
Spray Copper Oxychloride @ 3g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.1g/L for bacterial blight

weatherClimate.optimumTemperature: 25°C - 35°C during vegetative; 21°C - 28°C during boll bursting with bright sunshine
weatherClimate.rainfall: 600 - 800 mm with dry sunny weather during boll maturation
weatherClimate.weatherAlerts: Continuous cloudy days and high humidity promote flower shedding and grey mildew; unseasonal rain stains open cotton.

machineryEquipment: Battery knapsack sprayer with hollow cone nozzle
Cotton shredder for post-harvest stubble removal
irrigationInfrastructure: Drip irrigation kit with inline emitters (2 LPH at 60 cm interval)
storageHandling: Clean cement yard protected from dust and cattle
Clean cotton cloth bags (Avoid polythene or plastic strings to prevent lint contamination)

harvestingPeriod.maturityIndicators: Bolls burst open fully revealing clean, white, fluffy seed cotton; bolls feel dry to the touch.
harvestingPeriod.harvestMoisture: <= 8% moisture for safe ginning and market delivery.
harvestingPeriod.postHarvestCare: Pick in 3-4 pickings; dry under morning sun for 3-4 hours; store in dry, fire-safe shed away from kerosene/diesel fumes.

January.task: Harvest Rabi groundnut when 75% pods are mature
Windrow and sun-cure for 3-4 days before threshing

February.task: Separate pods; dry to 8% moisture for storage
Summer crop sowing in sandy loam soils with irrigation

March.task: Summer groundnut: TAG-24, CO-2 varieties; 30x10 cm
Apply 5 t/ha FYM + Gypsum 200 kg/ha at sowing

April.task: Monitor for leaf miner; apply Dimethoate 30EC if needed

May.task: Summer groundnut harvest; peg zone irrigation critical
Field preparation for Kharif: plough 25 cm deep

June.task: Kharif sowing at onset of monsoon: TMV-2, JL-24 varieties
Basal: SSP @400 kg/ha + Rhizobium seed treatment

July.task: Apply Gypsum @200 kg/ha at pegging stage (30-35 DAS)
Avoid water stress at flowering and pegging stage
Spray Mancozeb for early leaf spot if symptoms appear

August.task: Monitor for late leaf spot and rust; spray Chlorothalonil
Irrigate at pod development (most critical stage)

September.task: Harvest Kharif crop: 60-75% pods have dark veins inside
Dry quickly to prevent Aflatoxin contamination

October.task: Complete harvest; avoid delays as aflatoxin risk increases
Rabi groundnut sowing (AP, TN coastal belts): K-6, Dh-86

November.task: Rabi basal: SSP 500 kg + Gypsum 200 kg/ha
Provide life irrigation at peg zone in Rabi crop

December.task: Critical irrigation at pod development in Rabi crop
Scout for thrips damage on Rabi crop; spray Acephate if severe

activities: Pre-sowing seed treatment with Rhizobium and Trichoderma
Broadbed and Furrow (BBF) sowing
Gap filling within 7-10 days
stages.irrigation: Sow in good soil moisture; first life irrigation at 7-10 DAS if dry
stages.nutrition: Basal: SSP @ 150 kg/acre + 25 kg Urea + 25 kg MOP + 100 kg Gypsum/acre
stages.plantProtection: Seed treatment with Imidacloprid 600 FS @ 6 ml/kg seed against white grubs

activities: Profuse yellow flower appearance
Pegs emerge and penetrate soil (geocarpy)
Strictly avoid hoeing once pegging begins
stages.irrigation: Critical irrigation at flowering and peg entry into soil (40-45 DAS)
stages.nutrition: Apply Gypsum @ 200 kg/acre at 40-45 DAS around base; Calcium is critical for pod filling
stages.plantProtection: Spray Chlorpyrifos 20 EC @ 2 ml/L into soil if white grub observed

activities: Underground pod enlargement and shell hardening
Maintain loose, moist friable topsoil in peg zone
Scout for Tikka leaf spot on lower canopy
stages.irrigation: Most critical water requirement stage; maintain optimum soil moisture for pod development
stages.nutrition: Foliar spray of 0.5% Ferrous Sulphate + 0.1% Citric acid if iron chlorosis (yellowing) appears
stages.plantProtection: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5g/L or Hexaconazole 5 SC @ 1.5 ml/L for Tikka and Rust

activities: Pull out sample plants to inspect inside of shell (dark brown/black lining means mature)
Harvest by pulling or tractor digger in moist soil
Windrow and sun-cure pods in field for 3-4 days
stages.irrigation: Give light irrigation 2-3 days before pulling if soil is hard/dry to prevent pod detachment in soil
stages.nutrition: Nil
stages.plantProtection: Dry pods quickly to <= 8% moisture to prevent Aspergillus flavus (Aflatoxin) fungus

preferredSoils: Light Loamy Soils with excellent drainage
landSoilRequirements.fieldPreparation: Plough 15-20 cm deep; avoid excessive pulverization; form Broad Bed and Furrows (BBF: 120 cm bed, 30 cm furrow) for better aeration and drainage.

irrigationRequirements.method: Sprinkler Irrigation (Highly Recommended) or Furrow Irrigation
irrigationRequirements.intervals: Irrigate every 10-12 days; keep pegging zone friable.

fertilizerNutrientRequirements.basalApplication: Full N, full P (as Single Super Phosphate), and full K at sowing.
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.topDressing: Gypsum @ 400-500 kg/ha at pegging stage (40-45 DAS) placed 5 cm around plants.
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate @ 25 kg/ha + Borax @ 10 kg/ha basal for pod filling.
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.organicBiofertilizers: Rhizobium leguminosarum + PSB seed treatment @ 50g each per kg seed.

sowingPlantingInfo.sowingWindow: Kharif: June 15 - July 15; Rabi: October 15 - November 15; Summer: Jan 15 - Feb 15
sowingPlantingInfo.spacing: 30 cm x 10 cm (Bunch type) or 45 cm x 15 cm (Spreading)
sowingPlantingInfo.seedTreatment: Trichoderma viride @ 4g/kg + Imidacloprid 600 FS @ 2ml/kg + Rhizobium culture

weedingRequirements.criticalPeriod: First 35 days after sowing (Do NOT weed or disturb soil after 45 DAS to protect delicate pegs)
weedingRequirements.herbicideRecommendations: Pre-emergence: Pendimethalin 30 EC @ 1 L/acre within 2 days of sowing; Post-emergence: Imazethapyr 10 SL @ 300 ml/acre at 20 DAS.
weedingRequirements.manualInterculture: One hand weeding at 20-25 DAS before flowering.

preventiveCulturalPractices: Soil application of Phorate 10G or Chlorpyrifos for white grub
Crop rotation with cereals (Maize/Bajra)
Dry pods rapidly to prevent Aspergillus mould

weatherClimate.optimumTemperature: 25°C - 30°C for vegetative and flowering; warm sunny weather during ripening
weatherClimate.weatherAlerts: Waterlogging for > 24 hours causes severe pod rotting; ensure unobstructed surface drainage.

irrigationInfrastructure: Sprinkler pipes with rotating nozzles to apply uniform mist on pegging zone
storageHandling: Breathable gunny bags (Do not store in plastic/airtight bags)

harvestingPeriod.maturityIndicators: Vines begin to yellow and drop lower leaves; inner shell of pods shows dark brown/black reticulation; kernels separate easily from shell.
harvestingPeriod.harvestMoisture: <= 8% moisture in pods for safe commercial storage.
harvestingPeriod.postHarvestCare: Sun-dry harvested pods on threshing floor for 5-7 days; check that rattling sound is heard when shaken.

January.task: Harvest red-ripe chili; sun-dry to <=12% moisture

February.task: Final red chili pickings; grade and pack for sale
Apply foliar boron 0.2% to improve fruit set

March.task: Raise nursery for summer-Kharif crop (seed rate: 500 g/ha)
Treat nursery with Carbofuran 3G @15 g/m2 for cutworms

April.task: Basal: N 50 + P 75 + K 50 kg/ha + FYM 25 t/ha

May.task: Irrigate every 7-10 days; mulch to conserve moisture
Install blue sticky traps @40/ha for thrips monitoring

June.task: Apply Spinosad 45 SC for thrips; Diafenthiuron for mites

July.task: Spray Imidacloprid @0.3 mL/L for vector-borne virus control
Avoid waterlogging; provide good drainage in heavy rains

August.task: Apply copper-based fungicide for Phytophthora fruit rot
First green chili harvest at 60-70 DAT

September.task: Continue green/red harvest based on market price
Apply MKP @0.5% foliar for fruit bulking

October.task: Rabi nursery raising for winter crop
Red chili picking; begin field drying in sunny weather

November.task: Transplant Rabi nursery; apply basal fertilizers

December.task: Weekly irrigation; protect from frost in north India
Spray neem oil 2% for aphids and whitefly

activities: Raise nursery on raised beds (15 cm high)
Pro-tray seedling production under shade net
Transplant 35-40 day seedlings at 60x45 cm spacing
stages.irrigation: Light irrigation every 2-3 days in nursery; life irrigation immediately upon transplanting
stages.nutrition: Basal: FYM 10 t/ha + 50 kg N + 75 kg P + 50 kg K/ha
stages.plantProtection: Treat nursery with Carbofuran 3G @ 10 g/m2 for cutworms; seed treatment with Trichoderma 4g/kg

activities: Primary and secondary branch proliferation
Install blue and yellow sticky traps for thrips and whitefly
Manual weeding and earthing up
stages.irrigation: Irrigate every 6-8 days; avoid water stagnation
stages.nutrition: 1st Top dressing: 25 kg N/ha at 30 DAT; foliar spray of 19:19:19 @ 5g/L
stages.plantProtection: Spray Spinosad 45 SC @ 0.3 ml/L for thrips; Diafenthiuron 50 WP @ 1.25 g/L for yellow mites

activities: Flowering clusters and young green chili setting
Foliar spray of Planofix (NAA) @ 0.25 ml/L to prevent flower drop
Stake tall varieties if heavy fruit set
stages.irrigation: Regular light irrigations; moisture stress causes flower drop
stages.nutrition: 2nd Top dressing: 25 kg N + 25 kg K/ha at flowering; spray Boron 0.2% for pollination
stages.plantProtection: Spray Imidacloprid @ 0.3 ml/L for vector-borne Leaf Curl Virus control; spray Mancozeb for anthracnose

activities: Pick green chilies at 60-70 DAT; allow red ripe chilies to color on vine for dry chili
Repeat pickings every 10-14 days
Sun-dry red ripe chilies on clean polythene sheet
stages.irrigation: Maintain irrigation between picking rounds to sustain continuous flushes
stages.nutrition: Foliar spray of Potassium Schoenite or 00:00:50 @ 5g/L for fruit shine and color
stages.plantProtection: Spray Azoxystrobin 23 SC @ 1 ml/L for Dieback/Anthracnose fruit rot

landSoilRequirements.fieldPreparation: 2-3 deep ploughings followed by rotavator; incorporate 15-20 tonnes FYM/ha; make ridges and furrows at 60 cm spacing.

irrigationRequirements.intervals: Irrigate every 5-7 days under furrow; daily or alternate days under drip (2-3 hours/day).

fertilizerNutrientRequirements.basalApplication: 50 kg N + 75 kg P + 50 kg K + 25 kg Zinc Sulphate at transplanting.
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.topDressing: Split remaining 100 kg N + 25 kg K into 4 equal doses at 30, 60, 90, and 120 DAT.
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.micronutrients: Foliar spray of Micronutrient mixture (Formula 4) @ 2.5 ml/L at flowering.
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.organicBiofertilizers: Neem cake @ 250 kg/acre at planting to control root nematodes; Pseudomonas fluorescens root dip.

sowingPlantingInfo.sowingWindow: Kharif: May-June nursery (July transplant); Rabi: Oct nursery (Nov transplant); Summer: Jan-Feb
sowingPlantingInfo.spacing: 60 cm row x 45 cm plant or paired row 90 x 60 x 45 cm under drip
sowingPlantingInfo.sowingDepth: 0.5 - 1 cm in pro-trays; transplant seedling at nursery root collar depth

weedingRequirements.herbicideRecommendations: Pre-emergence: Pendimethalin 30 EC @ 1 L/acre applied before transplanting; Post-emergence: Quizalofop-ethyl 5 EC @ 400 ml/acre for grass weeds.
weedingRequirements.manualInterculture: Hand weeding at 25 and 50 DAT followed by earthing up.

majorPests: Chili Thrips (Scirtothrips dorsalis - upward leaf curling)
majorDiseases: Chili Leaf Curl Virus (transmitted by whitefly)
preventiveCulturalPractices: Install blue sticky traps for thrips @ 20/acre
Grow 2 rows of Maize or Jowar as border crop to block vector insects
Spray Copper Oxychloride for fruit rot

weatherClimate.optimumTemperature: 20°C - 30°C; frost-free warm humid climate during growth; dry warm weather during ripening
weatherClimate.weatherAlerts: Water stagnation causes sudden wilt and root rot; ensure raised bed drainage during monsoon storms.

machineryEquipment: Solar tunnel dryer or clean drying sheets
irrigationInfrastructure: Drip irrigation system with Venturi fertigation injector
storageHandling: Cold storage at 4°C - 7°C for green chilies; dry red chilies stored in clean gunny bags in dry aerated godowns

harvestingPeriod.maturityIndicators: Green chili: firm, fully grown with pungent smell; Red chili: fully turned deep red on the vine.
harvestingPeriod.postHarvestCare: Dry red chilies on clean cement drying floor for 8-10 days; turn twice daily; grade by size and color.

January.task: Peak Rabi harvest; grade for market (A/B/C grade)
Fertigation: K2O 60 kg/ha to improve shelf-life and colour

February.task: Continue harvest; protect from cold nights with poly cover
Raise summer crop nursery: Arka Vikas, Rashmi varieties

March.task: Transplant summer crop; 60x45 cm spacing with stakes
Install pheromone traps for fruit borer @20/ha

April.task: Drip irrigation daily; avoid moisture stress at fruit set
Spray Spinosad for Helicoverpa armigera if >10% damage

May.task: Summer crop harvest; sell quickly (short shelf life in heat)
Prepare raised beds for Kharif nursery

June.task: Kharif nursery: treat with Trichoderma to prevent damping off
Basal: FYM 25 t + N 60 + P 90 + K 60 kg/ha

July.task: Apply Mancozeb for early blight; avoid wet foliage in rains

August.task: Late blight risk: spray Metalaxyl-Mancozeb preventively
1st top-dressing: N @30 kg/ha at first flower

September.task: Monitor for tomato leaf curl virus via whitefly control
Early Kharif harvest begins; grade and pack carefully

October.task: Rabi nursery raising: PKM-1, Arka Samrat, hybrid BL-410
Peak Kharif harvest; cooperate with FPO for bulk rates

November.task: Rabi transplanting with irrigation; mulch beds
Apply Ca+Mg foliar 0.5% to prevent blossom end rot

December.task: Protect from frost; use drip micro-jets for frost protection
Scout for root-knot nematode in sandy soils; apply Neem cake

activities: Pro-tray nursery under 50% shade net
Raised bed main field preparation
Transplant 25-day seedlings with root dip
stages.irrigation: Light sprinkler in nursery; life irrigation immediately after transplanting
stages.nutrition: Basal: FYM 10 t/acre + N:P:K 40:60:40 kg/acre + 10 kg Zinc Sulphate
stages.plantProtection: Trichoderma viride root dip to prevent damping-off

activities: Staking plants with bamboo poles and GI wire for indeterminate hybrids
Pruning side suckers up to 30 cm height
Weeding and earthing up
stages.irrigation: Drip irrigation daily or alternate days (15-20 liters/plant/week)
stages.nutrition: Fertigation: 19:19:19 @ 3 kg/acre twice a week; Calcium Nitrate @ 2 kg/acre
stages.plantProtection: Install yellow sticky traps for whitefly; spray Neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 2 ml/L

activities: Peak flowering and fruit cluster formation
Install pheromone traps for Helicoverpa fruit borer @ 15/acre
Foliar spray of Micronutrients + Boron
stages.irrigation: Maintain consistent soil moisture; irregular watering causes Blossom End Rot and fruit cracking
stages.nutrition: Fertigation with 13:0:45 (Potassium Nitrate) @ 4 kg/acre + Boron 0.2% foliar
stages.plantProtection: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC (Coragen) @ 0.3 ml/L for fruit borer; Mancozeb @ 2.5g/L for Early Blight

activities: Harvest at breaker/turning stage for long-distance transport
Harvest at pink/red-ripe stage for local market
Grade into A, B, C categories in plastic crates
stages.irrigation: Continue light drip irrigation to nourish successive fruit flushes
stages.nutrition: Fertigation with 0:0:50 (Potassium Sulphate) @ 3 kg/acre for fruit firmness
stages.plantProtection: Spray Metalaxyl-Mancozeb @ 2g/L if Late Blight threatens during cloudy rainy spells

preferredSoils: Clay Loam with high organic matter
landSoilRequirements.fieldPreparation: 2 deep ploughings, rotavator, incorporate FYM 10 t/acre; make raised beds 90 cm wide, 15 cm high with 30 cm furrow.

irrigationRequirements.intervals: Daily drip irrigation based on crop evapotranspiration.

fertilizerNutrientRequirements.basalApplication: 40 kg N + 100 kg P + 50 kg K basal per hectare.
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.topDressing: Remaining 140 kg N + 100 kg K applied through drip fertigation in weekly split doses.
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.micronutrients: Calcium Nitrate + Boron foliar spray at fruit set to prevent Blossom End Rot.
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.organicBiofertilizers: FYM @ 25 t/ha; Azospirillum + Phosphobacteria seedling dip.

sowingPlantingInfo.sowingWindow: Kharif: June-July; Rabi: Sept-Oct; Summer: Dec-Jan
sowingPlantingInfo.seedRatePerAcre: 50 - 60 g/acre for indeterminate hybrids; 100 - 150 g/acre for OP varieties
sowingPlantingInfo.spacing: 90 cm x 60 cm (Determinate) or 120 cm x 45 cm (Staked Indeterminate)
sowingPlantingInfo.sowingDepth: 0.5 cm in pro-trays; transplant seedling firmly at collar

weedingRequirements.criticalPeriod: First 30 days after transplanting (Silver-black plastic mulch recommended)
weedingRequirements.herbicideRecommendations: Pre-emergence: Pendimethalin 30 EC @ 1 L/acre applied before laying mulch.
weedingRequirements.manualInterculture: Hand weeding around plant holes at 20 and 40 DAT.

preventiveCulturalPractices: Use ToLCV resistant hybrids (Arka Samrat, US-440)
Staking prevents fruits touching wet soil
Pheromone traps @ 12/acre for Tuta absoluta and Helicoverpa

weatherClimate.weatherAlerts: Night temperatures > 27°C or < 12°C cause severe flower drop and poor pollination.

irrigationInfrastructure: Drip system with inline drippers (16 mm lateral, 40 cm spacing, 2 LPH)
storageHandling: Shaded packing shed with grading table
Cold room storage at 10°C - 12°C for 2-3 weeks shelf life

harvestingPeriod.maturityIndicators: Breaker stage (10% pinkish blush at blossom end) for distance transport; full red for local processing.
harvestingPeriod.postHarvestCare: Wipe with clean dry cloth, sort out damaged/cracked fruits, pack in ventilated 20 kg plastic crates.

January.task: Harvest Rabi maize when cob husk turns brown (25% moisture)
Dry grain to <=12% for safe storage

February.task: Threshing, cleaning, and bagging; sell when price is high
Prepare summer maize field (irrigated areas only)

March.task: Summer maize sowing: DHM-117, Pioneer 30V92 hybrids
Basal: N 60 + P 80 + K 40 kg/ha; Zinc Sulphate 25 kg/ha

April.task: Irrigation every 7-10 days; critical at tasseling
Spray Cartap Hydrochloride for stem borer

May.task: Summer crop harvest at milk/dough stage for fodder
Field preparation for Kharif: plough 20-25 cm deep

June.task: Kharif maize sowing at first rain: spacing 60x20 cm
Basal: N 60 + P 60 + K 30 kg/ha at sowing
Seed treatment with Imidacloprid 48 FS @1 mL/kg

July.task: 1st N top-dressing @60 kg/ha at knee-high (V6) stage
Monitor Fall Armyworm; spray Emamectin if whorl damage >10%
Irrigation at tasseling and silking is most critical

August.task: Apply Tricyclazole for turcicum blight in humid conditions

September.task: Harvest at dough-ripe stage for baby corn or silage
Grain crop harvest when husks are dry and grain hard

October.task: Rabi maize sowing (TN, AP, KA): DHM-117, HQPM-1

November.task: 1st N top-dressing @40 kg/ha at V6 stage in Rabi
Rabi critical irrigations: tasseling, silking, grain fill

December.task: FAW monitoring in Rabi crop; same management as Kharif
Foliar spray Zinc EDTA 0.5% to correct deficiency

activities: Ridges and furrow sowing at 60x20 cm
Thinning to single seedling per hill at 12 DAS
Gap filling with pre-germinated seed
stages.irrigation: Sow in moist seedbed; life irrigation at 5-7 DAS if soil dry
stages.nutrition: Basal: 25% N + 100% P + 50% K + 10 kg Zinc Sulphate/acre
stages.plantProtection: Crucial Fall Armyworm (FAW) monitoring from 7 DAS; seed treatment with Cyantraniliprole (Fortenza Duo)

activities: Rapid stem elongation and leaf canopy development
Mechanical inter-cultivation and earthing-up
Scout whorls for FAW shot-hole pin holes
stages.irrigation: Irrigate every 10-12 days; prevent dry spells
stages.nutrition: 1st Top dressing: 35% Nitrogen (Urea @ 40 kg/acre) at knee-high stage (30 DAS) followed by earthing up
stages.plantProtection: Apply Emamectin Benzoate 5 SG @ 0.4g/L or Spinetoram 11.7 SC @ 0.5 ml/L into the plant whorl for FAW

activities: Tassel emergence (male) and silk emergence (female)
Critical pollination window
Avoid any water or heat stress
stages.irrigation: Most critical irrigation stage; water deficit for 2 days at silking reduces yield by 25-40%
stages.nutrition: 2nd Top dressing: 30% Nitrogen + 50% Potash at tasseling stage (50-55 DAS)
stages.plantProtection: Monitor for Turcicum leaf blight; spray Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole @ 1 ml/L

activities: Milk stage -> Dough stage -> Dent stage -> Black layer formation
Cob husks turn dry, papery and pale yellow
Harvest cobs when black layer appears at grain base
stages.irrigation: Maintain soil moisture till dough stage; cease watering 10 days before harvest
stages.nutrition: Foliar spray of 1% Zinc EDTA if leaf striping observed
stages.plantProtection: Protect sweet corn / grain cobs from birds and rodents

landSoilRequirements.fieldPreparation: 1 deep summer ploughing followed by 2 diskings and planking; make ridges and furrows at 60 cm interval.

irrigationRequirements.intervals: Irrigate every 8-12 days in Kharif dry spells; every 12-15 days in Rabi.

fertilizerNutrientRequirements.basalApplication: Apply 25% N + 100% P + 50% K + Zinc Sulphate 25 kg/ha at sowing.
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.topDressing: 35% N at knee-high (V6 stage), 30% N + 50% K at tasseling (V10 stage), 10% N at grain filling.
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate 21% @ 25 kg/ha basal (Maize is an indicator crop for Zinc deficiency).
fertilizerNutrientRequirements.organicBiofertilizers: FYM @ 10 t/ha; Azospirillum + Phosphobacteria seed inoculation.

sowingPlantingInfo.sowingWindow: Kharif: June 15 - July 15; Rabi: October 15 - November 15; Spring: Jan 15 - Feb 15
sowingPlantingInfo.seedRatePerAcre: 7 - 8 kg/acre for single cross hybrids; 9 - 10 kg/acre for composite varieties
sowingPlantingInfo.seedTreatment: Cyantraniliprole 19.8% + Thiamethoxam 19.8% FS (Fortenza Duo) @ 6 ml/kg seed for Fall Armyworm protection

weedingRequirements.herbicideRecommendations: Pre-emergence: Atrazine 50 WP @ 1 kg/acre applied within 2 days of sowing in moist soil; Post-emergence: Tembotrione 34.4 SC @ 115 ml/acre at 20-25 DAS.
weedingRequirements.manualInterculture: One hand weeding and inter-cultivation with bullock/tractor cultivator at 25 DAS followed by earthing-up.

preventiveCulturalPractices: Whorl application of sand + neem seed kernel powder (9:1 ratio)
Install FAW pheromone traps @ 5/acre
Deep ploughing to expose pupae to birds and sun

weatherClimate.optimumTemperature: 21°C - 30°C for growth; warm frost-free climate with warm nights
weatherClimate.weatherAlerts: Waterlogging for even 24-48 hours during early stages causes irreversible stunting; construct drainage furrows.

machineryEquipment: Tractor with pneumatic seed planter or ridge seeder
irrigationInfrastructure: Furrow layout or drip lateral lines (16 mm, 50 cm drippers)
storageHandling: Gunny bags, moisture meter to verify <= 12% moisture

harvestingPeriod.maturityIndicators: Cob husk leaves turn straw yellow and paper dry; grains turn hard and glassy; black layer forms at the tip of grain hilum.
harvestingPeriod.harvestMoisture: 20% - 22% cob moisture; shell after drying cobs in sun to <= 14% grain moisture.
harvestingPeriod.postHarvestCare: De-husk, dry cobs in sun for 3-5 days, shell using mechanical sheller, winnow, and pack dry grain at <= 12% moisture.
